sous_titre: Part des puces d'intelligence artificielle refroidies par liquide, en %, 2025 à 2027

series.nom: Part des puces refroidies par liquide

2025.texte: Liquid cooling penetration among AI chips is expected to increase from approximately 33% in 2025 to 53% in 2026.

2026.texte: Liquid cooling penetration among AI chips is projected to rise to 53% in 2026 and approach 60% in 2027.

2027.texte: Liquid cooling penetration among AI chips is projected to rise to 53% in 2026 and approach 60% in 2027.
